title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
description:

Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?
About the Team
The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.
Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.
Key team values:

• Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals

• Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support

• Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth

• Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead

About the Job
As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.

• Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.

• Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).

• Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.

• Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.

• Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.

• Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.

• Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.

About You
You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.
You will be successful in this role if you:

• Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.

• Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.

• Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.

title: Registered Nurse (RN) - Bilingual (Vietnamese - English)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join our team as a Telehealth Medicare Annual Wellness Visit Specialist - PRN. In this remote role, you will be responsible for conducting Medicare Annual Wellness Visits (AWVs) via telehealth under the direct supervision of a physician. This position focuses on preventive healthcare, patient education, and the assessment of individual health risks, all conducted through virtual platforms to promote better health outcomes for our Medicare population.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

• Conducting Medicare Annual Wellness Visits via telehealth in accordance with CMS guidelines, ensuring all required assessments and screenings are completed.

• Virtually reviewing and updating patient medical histories, including medication lists, immunization records, and family history.

• Assessing patients’ current health status, including vital signs when available, cognitive function, and risk factors for chronic diseases, utilizing remote monitoring tools when applicable.

• Providing patient education on preventive measures, lifestyle changes, and available community resources to promote overall health and well-being through virtual consultations.

• Developing and updating personalized prevention plans based on individual patient needs and physician guidance.

• Collaborating with the supervising physician to ensure accurate documentation and follow-up on any identified health concerns using electronic health record systems.

• Identifying any HCC codes requiring recapture reporting to CMS.

• Maintaining comprehensive and accurate patient records in compliance with HIPAA and organizational standards, particularly in a remote environment.

• Facilitating virtual referrals to appropriate healthcare services and specialists as needed.

• Monitoring patient progress and adherence to personalized prevention plans, providing support and making adjustments as necessary through telehealth follow-ups.

• Staying current on Medicare guidelines, telehealth best practices, preventive care practices, and chronic disease management strategies.

• Participating in virtual team meetings, training sessions, and continuing education to maintain and enhance clinical skills.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED FOR SUCCESS

• Must be fully bilingual in Viatnamese and English.

• Must be located in GA.

• Current and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of GA.

• Availability for PRN work Monday through Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm, aproxametly 20 hours per week.

• Minimum of 3 years of patient care nursing experience, preferably in a primary care, preventive care, or telehealth setting.

• Experience with Medicare Annual Wellness Visits (AWVs) and telehealth platforms is highly desirable.

• Strong knowledge of Medicare guidelines, telehealth practices, and preventive care strategies preferred.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to educate and engage patients effectively in a virtual environment.

• Proficient in electronic health records (EHR) systems, telehealth technology, and remote medical documentation.

• Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote work setting.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

The salary range for this role is $42/hour (PRN) plus language differential

description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Summary:

The Electrical and Electronics Test Technician is responsible for performing functional, environmental, and diagnostic testing on electrical and electronic components, assemblies, and systems. This role ensures all products meet design specifications, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. The technician will work closely with engineers to identify issues, troubleshoot failures, and maintain test equipment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Perform electrical and electronic testing of components, subassemblies, and final products according to engineering specifications and test procedures.

• Operate and maintain automated and manual test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, and specialized test setups.

• Conduct functional, continuity, insulation resistance, hipot, and performance testing.

• Assist in environmental testing, including thermal cycling, vibration, burn-in, and other reliability assessments.

• Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, test plans, and technical documents to execute test procedures.

• Identify, isolate, and troubleshoot electrical and electronic failures; document findings and recommend corrective actions.

• Record test results accurately in logs, reports, or databases to ensure traceability and compliance.

• Support engineering teams during product development, validation, and qualification activities.

• Maintain calibration, safety, and operational readiness of test stations and equipment.

• Follow all ESD, safety, and cleanroom protocols where applicable.

• Assist in developing and improving test fixtures, setups, and documentation.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues and improve product reliability.

Qualifications:

• Associate degree or technical diploma in Electronics, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).

• 2+ years of experience in electrical/electronic test environments preferred.

• Strong knowledge of electronic components, analog/digital circuits, and electrical measurement principles.

• Hands-on experience with test equipment (oscilloscope, DMM, hipot tester, function generator, etc.).

• Ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings.

• Proficiency with MS Office and familiarity with test data collection software or ERP/MES systems.

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

• IPC, J-STD-001, or related electronics assembly/testing certifications are a plus.

• Familiarity with ISO 9001, AS9100, or aerospace/defense/military standards is desirable.

title: Animator & Motion Graphics Designer
description:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

- A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

- PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

- Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog.

 

THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

- Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

- Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

- Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams - autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

- Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication - PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

- Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.

WHY THIS ROLE AT POSTHOG NOW?

We have a strong brand and a lot of strong content for you to build on. What we don't have (yet) is someone whose whole job is making it move.

You'll be PostHog's first in-house video animator, and the creative engine behind everything that moves in our visuals.

We take video seriously (although we’re not really so serious https://posthog.com/trash). Our Video team ships documentaries, product launches, ads, social shorts, and more.

You will be the vital link between our product's architecture and our clients' varied technical landscapes. About Epistemix
The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.
We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.
Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. We are approaching our Series B and actively building the team that will define what comes next.

title: Amazon Image Brief & Conversion Associate
description:
Amazon images are where most listings win or lose. The main image decides whether anyone clicks. The six behind it decide whether they buy - and whether the parcel comes back.
We are hiring one person to own that. Take a live listing, work out from its reviews and returns why it is not converting, and write the image brief that fixes it - a brief a remote designer can execute without a single follow-up question.
This is an operational and analytical role, not a design role. You will not be making the artwork. You decide what it has to say, in what order, and you hold the returned files to that standard.
The split is 75 / 25.

•
75% - the briefs. The conversion thinking, the ranked USPs, the seven slots, the QA of what comes back.

•
25% - analysis and reporting. Part of it is the work that feeds the brief: pulling the reviews, reading them properly, turning them into a persona and a pain-point list. The rest is the follow-up reporting we owe clients - sales and traffic, return reasons, and what actually moved once new images went live.

You will work across markets. Mostly European and US listings, across many markets and languages, in categories you have never shopped in yourself.
What you will do
Image briefs and conversion thinking - 75% of the role

• Diagnose why a listing is not converting: what the gallery fails to answer, which objection nobody addressed, where the buyer loses confidence and leaves.

• Know what each slot is for. The main image earns the click. Images two to seven answer objections in the order a buyer actually raises them. The size and fit slots decide whether the sale stays sold.

• Rank seven USPs by what wins the click and what prevents a return. They are not the same list, and the order is the decision.

• Write the brief for each slot in our template: one message per slot, one headline, an optional subline, a maximum of three to four callouts, every line adding something new.

• Apply the two-second rule. One idea per image, legible at thumbnail size on a phone. If a slot needs a paragraph to work, it is not a slot.

• Work inside the client’s brand book - colours, fonts, existing assets - naming exactly which asset to reuse and where the file lives.

• Keep sizing accurate and internally consistent: backend size chart against image size chart, US against EU conventions.

• Know Amazon image policy cold: main-image rules, no price, ratings, review counts or badges, and how the gallery renders on a phone.

• QA the returned files against the brief and say precisely why something is not working - hierarchy, contrast, whitespace, text density, whether a close-up box earns its place.

The analysis behind the briefs - part of the 25%

• Download the reviews yourself and read them properly: themes, frequency, and the exact words customers use.

• Pull Voice of the Customer and the return report, and weight return reasons against units actually sold.

• Turn that into a buyer persona and a ranked pain-point list - for categories you did not grow up in.

• Separate “we can fix this on the listing” from “the product is the problem”.

• Evidence only. Never invent a return reason, a measurement or a number, and ask when something is missing.

Reporting that follows up sales - the rest of the 25%

• Find and download the right reports without being walked through it: Sales & Traffic, Search Query Performance, Returns, Voice of the Customer.

• Build the recurring follow-ups: sales and traffic trend, return rate by size, conversion before and after an image update.

• Merge two exports on ASIN or SKU and produce a clean pivot, without hand-counting rows.

• Deliver a one-page summary that says what matters, why it matters and what to do about it. Not a data dump.

Making the workflow better with AI - across all of the above

• Use Claude and ChatGPT as part of the work, not as a novelty: review analysis, first-draft copy, translation, summarising exports.

• Work inside our Claude projects, with the context

Colure Health builds technology that amplifies the impact of real clinicians. Our care platform blends intelligent automation with compassionate workflows, helping physicians stay connected to their patients and deliver better outcomes with less friction. We believe innovation should serve people, and we’re committed to creating tools that empower every provider to improve the health, experience, and quality of life of the communities they serve.

POSITION SUMMARY

The IT Technical Support Specialist keeps Colure Health ’s people productive and secure. This role is the first point of contact for technology issues across the executive team, US staff and the international care team in the Philippines, Ecuador and Colombia. It manages devices, accounts and everyday systems, and applies the security controls that protect patient data. As Colure adds clinics and staff, this role will help build repeatable onboarding, offboarding and support processes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

End-User Support

• Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support by ticket, chat, phone and remote session for hardware, software, accounts, VoIP and connectivity.

• Troubleshoot issues affecting care coordinators and enrollment staff, including softphones, headsets, CRM and platform access, and home-network problems, often across time zones.

• Document resolutions and maintain the knowledge base and self-help guides.

Accounts and Access

• Provision and deprovision user accounts, email, licenses and application access, in coordination with HR and in line with least-privilege principles.

• Complete same-day access removal at offboarding and support periodic access reviews.

• Administer password resets, MFA enrollment and single sign-on support.

Devices and Assets

• Configure, enroll and maintain laptops and mobile devices in mobile device management (MDM), with encryption, screen lock and endpoint protection enforced.

• Maintain the hardware and software asset inventory, including shipping, retrieval and secure wiping of devices.

• Apply patches and updates, and track compliance with device security standards.

Systems and Security Support

• Administer productivity and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, the phone system and video conferencing.

• Support the Cybersecurity Specialist with phishing reports, alert triage, and evidence collection for audits.

• Set up technology for new clinic locations, including workstations, printers, networking and peripherals, with vendor coordination as needed.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2+ years of IT help desk or desktop support experience.

• Hands-on experience with Windows and macOS, Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and an MDM platform such as Intune, Jamf or Kandji.

• Comfortable supporting remote users, including some international users, by phone, chat and remote-access tools.

• Understanding of basic networking (DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN) and of security practices such as MFA and encryption.

• Clear, patient communication and strong documentation habits.

• Ability to work a schedule that covers part of US Eastern Time business hours, with occasional after-hours support.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• CompTIA A+, Network+ or Security+, or Google IT Support certification.

• Experience in a healthcare or other HIPAA-regulated environment.

• Experience with ticketing systems such as Jira Service Management, Freshservice or Zendesk.

• Experience with VoIP and contact-center platforms.

• Conversational Spanish, to support team members in Ecuador and Colombia.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

About the Role: We are seeking an experienced Senior Factoring Underwriter & Credit Specialist with direct, hands-on expertise in accounts receivable (A/R) factoring. In this role, you will lead the credit evaluation, risk structuring, and day-to-day portfolio oversight of invoice factoring facilities for high-growth e-commerce, CPG, and B2B wholesale businesses.

This role is specifically tailored for an expert who understands the operational, legal, and credit nuances of invoice factoring. Beyond analyzing classic financial statements, you will evaluate debtor creditworthiness, verify invoice authenticity, establish debtor credit limits, manage dilution risk, and ensure proper perfection of security interests (comprehensive UCC lien searches, UCC-1 filings, Notices of Assignment, and tri-party lockbox accounts). You will also collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Operations, and Risk teams to automate factoring workflows and shape the next generation of our working capital platform.

What You'll Do:

•
Factoring Credit Underwriting: Underwrite prospective client factoring facilities and establish credit limits on individual account debtors using credit agency reports (D&B, Experian, CreditSafe), payment trends, trade references, and financial statements.

•
UCC Search Analysis & Lien Perfection: Thoroughly read, interpret, and evaluate UCC lien searches, tax lien reports, and judgment filings; identify senior or conflicting security interests (blanket liens, inventory lenders, equipment PMSIs); and coordinate lien releases, terminations, subordination agreements, and intercreditor deeds to guarantee a first-priority position on factored accounts receivable.

•

Dilution & Reserve Management: Model and monitor dilution factors (chargebacks, trade discounts, returns, co-op advertising offsets) to set appropriate advance rates and reserve holdbacks.

Legal & Perfection Controls: Oversee UCC-1 financing statement filings, continuous lien maintenance (amendments/continuations), Notice of Assignment (NOA) deliveries, and lockbox/account control agreements (DACA).

•
Portfolio & Debtor Monitoring: Track ongoing portfolio collections, remittance trends, daily lockbox reconciliations, aged accounts receivable, unapplied cash, and early warning signs of borrower or debtor distress.

•
Product Collaboration: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Risk Operations teams to translate manual factoring operations, lien checking, and verification logic into scalable, automated fintech software features.

•
AI-Driven Efficiency: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to accelerate credit memo generation, extract data from complex debtor agreements, and streamline verification audit trails.

What You’ll Need:

•
Direct Factoring Experience (Mandatory): Minimum of 3+ years of direct, hands-on commercial accounts receivable (A/R) factoring underwriting experience (recourse or non-recourse) within a commercial finance company, factoring house, bank factoring division, or specialized fintech. (Note: Standalone MCA, revenue-based financing, or general unsecured lending experience will not satisfy this requirement.)

title: Finance Systems Lead
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

THE ROLE

ElevenLabs runs a deliberately lean finance team across 10+ legal entities and 40+ countries. The stack is built around NetSuite, Stripe, Ramp, Deel, HiBob and Pigment, with a BigQuery/dbt warehouse underneath. We want a close where people review exceptions and agents handle the rest. You'll own that stack, from architecture and integrations to controls and vendors. This is a builder role, not a ticket queue.

- Run NetSuite end to end. That covers multi-subsidiary setup, chart of accounts and segments, scripting and workflows, release management, and roles and segregation of duties as we build toward public-company controls.

- Own the integration layer: Stripe, Ramp, Deel and HiBob into NetSuite, and NetSuite into the warehouse. Month-end should reconcile by design instead of by hand.

- Lead selection and rollout of new systems, including usage-based billing and equity administration. You'll also handle the finance setup of every new entity.

- Build with AI, alongside our Automations and Data teams. Examples include agents and automations for invoice coding, people-cost reconciliations and accounting requests.

- Be the systems voice in finance decisions on new pricing models, new geographies and audit readiness.

REQUIREMENTS

- You've administered a multi-entity NetSuite OneWorld instance yourself, including SuiteScript

title: Head of Video (all genders)
description:
The role

As Head of Video, Berlin, you will shape how HelloFresh makes video for our international markets: the paid social engine, organic social, and our long-form YouTube content. Building and managing the team and systems behind all of it. You will lead the Berlin video team, including our international XPod, our fast and experimental content engine. Paid social is our biggest growth lever and the largest part of this role, but we do not want to lose the rest. Organic, long-form and brand storytelling all matter, and a strong Head of Video makes them work together. Whilst the scope is on our International market, we actively seek greater global collaboration. 

HelloFresh is at a pivotal moment of transformation. We are moving towards a modular, global content system, bringing AI-assisted workflows into how we plan, shoot and edit, and balancing centralised brand standards with local market needs. Berlin makes content for up to 14 markets that each need localisation, translation and cultural care, with local market teams who have a say on what ships. Our international XPod is a younger team than its New York counterpart, and part of your job is to bring it to the same standard, cadence and strategy.

You will need to be as comfortable discussing channel metrics, spend and creative testing as you are discussing a script or a shot. You will partner closely with the Growth, Creative Strategy and Brand teams, with the XPod Director in North America, and with our Photo, AI, Culinary and Studio Operations teams, and you will have a real voice in how video works across the whole group.

What you’ll do

Studio Leadership & People

A strong video team is how we keep creative capability and institutional knowledge through a period of rapid change. You will lead, develop and inspire the Berlin video team, across XPod, organic social and long-form.

• Set clear performance expectations, agree individual growth plans, and keep a healthy performance culture through regular 1:1s and honest, timely feedback.

• Build and develop a team that spans producers, editors, creative strategists and post-production, and create career paths that keep talent with us.

• Hire well, onboard well and keep the standard high as the team grows, including moving roles from freelance to full-time where it makes sense.

• Create an open, supportive team culture where concerns are raised early and good ideas can come from anyone.

Paid Social & Performance

Paid social is where we see the strongest return for the business. You will make international XPod a fast, reactive and experimental performance engine.

• Deliver paid social content that performs, to brief, prioritised with the Growth and channel teams.

• Run a clear test-and-learn rhythm across hooks, formats, creators and channels, and use performance data, including spend and cost per result, to decide what to make next.

• Attend regular Growth meetings to align on performance, localisation, trends and channel spend, and turn what you learn into briefs and shoot plans quickly.

• Build a lean creative strategy function inside the team that works hand in hand with Growth and Brand.

• Bring Berlin XPod up to the cadence, tooling and strategy of our most mature XPod team, and share one way of working.

Organic & Long-Form YouTube

We want to keep investing in organic and long-form content alongside paid. Both build the brand and feed the paid engine.

• Own the organic social video plan and grow it with the right talent, cadence and measures.

• Lead our long-form YouTube content, currently focused on the UK, and develop it into a global proposition where the audience and the budget support it.

• Make sure every long-form and organic shoot creates cut-downs, hooks and pickup shots that can serve paid, search and YouTube campaigns.

• Keep the quality and storytelling of our brand video high, from short-form to long-form.

Localisation & Modular Content

Berlin serves up to 14 m

Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

• Design and implement scalable hybrid multi-cloud Kubernetes platform solutions using your deep expertise in cloud-native infrastructure architecture and operations at scale

• Optimize and maintain high reliability of large-scale infrastructure platform systems

• Evaluate and integrate open-source technologies into existing systems workflows

• Provide insights and technical direction for the continued evolution of Kubernetes infrastructure services

• Mentor and help develop less-senior engineers to drive collaborative technical decision-making for infrastructure choices

What You’ll Need:

• Must be eligible for CJIS clearance (requires U.S. citizenship or Green Card/permanent resident status)

• 5+ years of Kubernetes experience including management of clusters with thousands of nodes

• Prometheus

• Thanos

• Alertmanager

• Golang

• Experience with large scale, business-critical Linux environments

• Experience operating in clouds: AWS, GCP, OCI

title: Head of Pricing & Packaging
description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

Pricing is one of the biggest levers Zip has to capture the value we create for customers, and today it is shared across Product, Deal Strategy/Ops, and Product Marketing. As Zip's first Head of Pricing & Packaging, you will own pricing and packaging as one function, with a single strategy, a single set of rules, and a single process for getting new products to the field.

- You own the whole function: strategy, packaging, governance, and the operating rhythm. There is no existing team, playbook, or system to inherit.

- You are both the strategist and the doer. You will build the models, run the research, write the policies, and make the call, then defend it in front of founders and the executive team.

- You will work through Product, Product Marketing, Deal Strategy/Ops, Sales, Finance, and Legal without formal authority over any of them.

- Headcount will be earned. You will decide what the function needs, size it, and make the business case for it. Expect to start as a team of one.

YOU WILL

PRICING STRATEGY AND PACKAGING

- Own pricing strategy across Zip's portfolio, including new product and module pricing, packaging tiers, and bundling.

- Run willingness-to-pay and competitive research (conjoint, Van Westendorp, benchmarking) and turn it into clear recommendations grounded in customer value.

- Design packaging that is simple for buyers to understand and leaves room for expansion.

- Chair a cross-functional pricing council that aligns Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing and drives decisions to resolution.

- Build and own a new product introduction (NPI) process that carries the product roadmap through to field readiness.

PRICING OPERATIONS AND GOVERNANCE

- Stand up what doesn't exist today: discounting policy, approval workflows, exception governance, and deal desk guardrails, in partnership with the existing Deal Desk team.

- Define and report on pricing KPIs, including win rate by price point, discount leakage, price realization, and expansion ARR from packaging changes.

- Evaluate pricing and CPQ tooling with Deal Desk as Zip's needs mature.

LEADERSHIP

- Be the company's authority on monetization, bringing market and competitive pricing intelligence into executive and product planning.

- Present pricing recommendations and business cases to the founders and executive team.

- Build the case, roadmap, and hiring plan for a pricing team as the function matures.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years in pricing strategy, monetization, or revenue strategy, including 5+ years owning pricing and packaging at a B2B SaaS or technology company.

- Ownership of pricing and packaging for a multi-product or platform business: you made and defended the decisions, not only the analysis behind them.

- A track record of building or substantially standing up a pricing or commercial strategy function, with measurable results such as NRR improvement, ARR acceleration, or competitive win-rate gains.

- Experience influencing founders, C-suite, or board-level audiences, and aligning Product, Sales, Fina
